title: hydrocotyle eccentrica var. pubescens
intro: Hydrocotyle eccentrica var. pubescens, commonly known as "Brazilian Pennywort", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to support overall health, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Brazilian Pennywort are attributed to its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
